# Is the French Riviera Pass Worth It When Staying in Menton?

The French Riviera Pass sounds like an excellent idea. Buy one ticket, visit famous museums and villas, enjoy a few activities, and save money along the way. But there's an important question if you're staying in Menton rather than Nice. Does the pass still save money after you include travel from Menton, the time spent between attractions and the cheaper tickets you could buy separately? Sometimes it does. Sometimes it doesn't come close.

A €30 pass can make sense for a concentrated programme of genuinely valuable included activities. But it is a poor purchase for two historic villas with a €24 combined ticket, or for a short perfume workshop sold directly for €18. And a 72-hour pass doesn't necessarily make sense because your holiday lasts three days. Let's compare realistic trips, using Menton as the starting point.

# Le French Riviera Pass est-il intéressant quand on séjourne à Menton ?

Le French Riviera Pass semble une excellente idée : un seul achat pour des musées, des villas et des activités, avec des économies à la clé. Mais lorsque l'on séjourne à Menton plutôt qu'à Nice, il faut aussi compter les trajets, les correspondances et les billets combinés moins chers.

Un pass à €30 peut convenir à un programme dense d'activités réellement utiles. Il est en revanche trop cher pour deux villas accessibles avec un billet jumelé à €24, ou pour un atelier court vendu directement €18. Un séjour de trois jours ne justifie pas automatiquement le pass de 72 heures. Comparons des sorties réalistes au départ de Menton, par adulte, avec les tarifs vérifiés le 2 novembre 2026.

# Conviene il French Riviera Pass soggiornando a Mentone?

Il French Riviera Pass sembra un'ottima idea: un unico acquisto per musei, ville ed esperienze, risparmiando sulle visite. Ma chi soggiorna a Mentone anziché a Nizza deve considerare anche gli spostamenti, il tempo tra le attrazioni e i biglietti combinati più economici.

Un pass da €30 può funzionare per un programma concentrato di attività davvero desiderate. Non conviene invece per due ville con un biglietto congiunto da €24 o per un breve laboratorio venduto direttamente a €18. Neppure una vacanza di tre giorni giustifica automaticamente un pass di 72 ore. Confrontiamo itinerari realistici da Mentone, per adulto, con prezzi verificati il 2 novembre 2026.

## 1. What is the French Riviera Pass?

The French Riviera Pass is the official sightseeing pass offered by the Nice Côte d'Azur Metropolitan Tourist Office. It provides one-time access to a selection of more than 60 attractions and activities across Nice and the surrounding Riviera. Its current all-inclusive prices are:

| Pass | Price | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 24-hour pass | €30 | 24 consecutive hours |
| 48-hour pass | €45 | 48 consecutive hours |
| 72-hour pass | €65 | 72 consecutive hours |

The pass is delivered digitally as an e-ticket. Validity begins on first use. If you enter an attraction at 11 a.m. on Monday with a 24-hour pass, it remains valid until 11 a.m. on Tuesday. You can normally visit each included attraction once, not repeatedly. Certain activities require advance booking and may have age, seasonal or capacity restrictions.

### What isn't included?

This is the most important limitation for visitors based in Menton. Ordinary public transport is not included. You must separately pay for regional TER trains, local buses and trams unless you already hold another eligible ticket or transport pass. The French Riviera Pass does include certain tourist transport experiences, including the Nice Le Grand Tour sightseeing bus and Nice's tourist train, but these are not substitutes for the regional railway.

The pass is also not the same product as Pass SudAzur Explore, which is primarily a regional public-transport pass.

## 1. Qu'est-ce que le French Riviera Pass ?

Il s'agit du pass touristique officiel de l'Office de Tourisme Métropolitain Nice Côte d'Azur. Il donne un accès unique à plus de 60 sites et activités de Nice et des environs.

| Pass | Prix | Validité |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 24 heures | €30 | 24 heures consécutives |
| 48 heures | €45 | 48 heures consécutives |
| 72 heures | €65 | 72 heures consécutives |

Le billet est numérique et s'active à la première utilisation. Une entrée le lundi à 11 h active ainsi un pass de 24 heures jusqu'au mardi à 11 h. Chaque site se visite normalement une seule fois. Certaines prestations exigent une réservation et peuvent avoir des limites d'âge, de saison ou de capacité.

### Ce qui n'est pas inclus

**Les transports publics ordinaires ne sont pas compris.** TER, bus et tramways restent payants, sauf si vous possédez un autre titre valable. Le bus touristique Nice Le Grand Tour et le petit train de Nice font partie de certaines prestations, mais ne remplacent pas le réseau régional. Le French Riviera Pass ne doit pas être confondu avec le Pass SudAzur Explore, consacré principalement aux transports.

## 1. Che cos'è il French Riviera Pass?

È il pass turistico ufficiale dell'Ufficio del Turismo Metropolitano Nice Côte d'Azur. Consente un ingresso a una selezione di oltre 60 attrazioni e attività di Nizza e della Riviera circostante.

| --- | --- | --- |
| 24 ore | €30 | 24 ore consecutive |
| 48 ore | €45 | 48 ore consecutive |
| 72 ore | €65 | 72 ore consecutive |

Il biglietto è digitale e la validità parte dal primo utilizzo. Entrando il lunedì alle 11 con un pass di 24 ore, questo scade il martedì alle 11. Normalmente ogni attrazione si può visitare una volta, non ripetutamente. Alcune attività richiedono prenotazione e prevedono limiti di età, stagionalità o capienza.

### Che cosa non comprende?

**Il trasporto pubblico ordinario non è incluso.** Treni TER, autobus e tram vanno pagati separatamente, salvo possedere un altro titolo valido. Sono comprese alcune esperienze turistiche, come il bus Nice Le Grand Tour e il trenino di Nizza, ma non sostituiscono la ferrovia regionale. Il prodotto è distinto dal Pass SudAzur Explore, dedicato principalmente ai trasporti.

## 3. Scenario one: two beautiful Riviera villas in one day

Route: Menton → Beaulieu-sur-Mer → Saint-Jean-Cap-Ferrat → Menton Attractions: Villa Kérylos and Villa Ephrussi de Rothschild Time needed: Approximately 6–8 hours including transport and visits This is one of the most appealing cultural outings from Menton. Villa Kérylos is a remarkable reconstruction of an ancient Greek residence, overlooking the sea in Beaulieu-sur-Mer. Villa Ephrussi de Rothschild offers elaborate interiors and extraordinary themed gardens on Saint-Jean-Cap-Ferrat. Both are included in the French Riviera Pass. At first glance, the arithmetic appears straightforward.

€15 + €18 = €33. A €30 pass would save €3. Except there's a better option.

### The combined villa ticket

The two properties offer an official combined admission costing **€24 for an adult**, valid for eight days from purchase. Ephrussi lists it as an on-site purchase; check the ticket-office conditions rather than assuming it can be bought online. You don't need to visit both properties on the same day. That's an important advantage if you enjoy gardens and don't want to rush.

### The real comparison

| Expense | Separate combined ticket | French Riviera Pass |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Villa Kérylos + Villa Ephrussi | €24 | Included |
| Pass | €0 | €30 |
| Transport from Menton | Extra | Extra |
| Attraction cost | €24 | €30 |

Result: buying the pass costs €6 more per adult. For two adults, that's €12 more before considering transport.

### What about the journey?

From Menton, take the TER towards Beaulieu-sur-Mer. Villa Kérylos is within walking distance of the station, but check the current pedestrian approach before travelling; temporary access restrictions can change. Villa Ephrussi is farther away on the Saint-Jean-Cap-Ferrat peninsula and requires additional walking or a local bus connection. Allow around 60–90 minutes at Kérylos and 2–3 hours at Ephrussi, especially if you enjoy gardens. You'll also need time for lunch and transfers.

### Verdict

Don't buy a French Riviera Pass solely for these two villas. Choose the combined €24 admission instead. It's cheaper and gives you eight days to organise the visits rather than forcing both into one continuous pass period.

## 3. Premier scénario : deux belles villas en une journée

Itinéraire : Menton → Beaulieu-sur-Mer → Saint-Jean-Cap-Ferrat → Menton. Visites : Kérylos et Ephrussi. Prévoyez environ 6 à 8 heures, transports compris : estimation éditoriale, non horaire garanti.

Kérylos reconstitue une demeure de la Grèce antique face à la mer. Ephrussi associe des intérieurs remarquables et des jardins thématiques sur la presqu'île du Cap Ferrat. Les deux sont incluses dans le pass. L'addition €15 + €18 = €33 paraît donner €3 d'économie avec le pass à €30. Mais il existe mieux.

### Le billet jumelé

Le billet officiel pour les deux villas coûte **€24 par adulte**, reste valable huit jours après l'achat et ne vous oblige pas à tout visiter le même jour. Il est proposé sur place : vérifiez les conditions de vente aux billetteries.

| Dépense | Billet jumelé séparé | French Riviera Pass |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Kérylos + Ephrussi | €24 | Inclus |
| Pass | €0 | €30 |
| Transport depuis Menton | En supplément | En supplément |
| Total des visites | €24 | €30 |

Le pass coûte donc **€6 de plus par adulte**, ou €12 pour deux, avant les transports.

### Le trajet et le rythme

Prenez un TER vers Beaulieu-sur-Mer. Kérylos se rejoint à pied depuis la gare ; vérifiez l'approche piétonne et les éventuelles restrictions temporaires. Ephrussi est plus loin, sur la presqu'île : ajoutez une marche ou une liaison en bus. Comptez environ 60–90 minutes à Kérylos et 2–3 heures à Ephrussi, plus déjeuner et transferts.

### Verdict

N'achetez pas le pass uniquement pour ces deux villas. Le billet jumelé est moins cher et permet de répartir les visites sur huit jours sans courir après une validité horaire.

## 3. Primo scenario: due splendide ville in un giorno

Percorso: Mentone → Beaulieu-sur-Mer → Saint-Jean-Cap-Ferrat → Mentone. Visite: Villa Kérylos ed Ephrussi. Prevedete circa 6–8 ore compresi i trasporti: è una stima editoriale, non una coincidenza garantita.

Kérylos ricostruisce un'abitazione dell'antica Grecia sul mare di Beaulieu. Ephrussi offre interni elaborati e giardini tematici sulla penisola di Cap Ferrat. Entrambe sono incluse nel pass. A prima vista, €15 + €18 = €33 farebbe risparmiare €3 acquistando il pass da €30. Ma esiste un'opzione migliore.

### Il biglietto congiunto

L'ingresso ufficiale combinato costa **€24 per adulto**, vale otto giorni dall'acquisto e non impone di visitare entrambe le ville nello stesso giorno. È disponibile sul posto: controllate le condizioni alle biglietterie.

| Spesa | Biglietto congiunto | French Riviera Pass |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Kérylos + Ephrussi | €24 | Incluse |
| Pass | €0 | €30 |
| Trasporto da Mentone | Extra | Extra |
| Costo delle visite | €24 | €30 |

Il pass costa **€6 in più per adulto**, quindi €12 in più per due, prima dei trasporti.

### Il viaggio e i tempi

Prendete il TER per Beaulieu-sur-Mer. Kérylos è raggiungibile a piedi dalla stazione; controllate l'accesso pedonale e le eventuali restrizioni temporanee. Ephrussi è più lontana, sulla penisola, e richiede un'altra camminata o un collegamento in autobus. Calcolate circa 60–90 minuti per Kérylos, 2–3 ore per Ephrussi e i giardini, oltre a pranzo e trasferimenti.

### Verdetto

Non acquistate il pass soltanto per queste ville. Il biglietto congiunto è meno caro e lascia otto giorni per organizzare le visite, senza costringervi nella finestra oraria del pass.

## 3. Сценарій перший: дві красиві вілли за день

Маршрут: Ментон → Больє-сюр-Мер → Сен-Жан-Кап-Ферра → Ментон. Пам'ятки: Керілос і Ефруссі. Передбачте приблизно 6–8 годин із дорогою: це редакційна оцінка, не гарантований розклад.

Керілос відтворює давньогрецький житловий будинок над морем у Больє. Ефруссі поєднує вишукані інтер'єри й тематичні сади на півострові Кап-Ферра. Обидві вілли входять у пас. Спершу арифметика проста: €15 + €18 = €33, тож пас за €30 нібито заощаджує €3. Але є кращий варіант.

### Спільний квиток

Офіційний комбінований вхід коштує **€24 для дорослого** та діє вісім днів від покупки. Відвідувати обидві вілли одного дня не обов'язково — це зручно, якщо ви любите сади й не хочете поспішати. Квиток продають на місці; перевірте умови в касі.

| Витрата | Окремий спільний квиток | French Riviera Pass |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Керілос + Ефруссі | €24 | Включено |
| Пас | €0 | €30 |
| Дорога з Ментона | Окремо | Окремо |
| Вартість відвідувань | €24 | €30 |

Отже, пас коштує **на €6 більше для дорослого**, або на €12 для двох, ще до транспортних витрат.

### Дорога й темп

Їдьте TER до Больє-сюр-Мер. До Керілос можна дійти від станції; перед поїздкою перевірте актуальний пішохідний підхід і тимчасові обмеження. Ефруссі далі, на півострові: потрібна додаткова прогулянка чи автобус. Закладіть орієнтовно 60–90 хвилин на Керілос, 2–3 години на Ефруссі й сади, а також обід і переїзд.

### Висновок

Не купуйте пас лише заради цих двох вілл. Спільний квиток дешевший і дозволяє рознести відвідування на вісім днів, а не вкладати їх у безперервний термін дії паса.

## 4. Scenario two: a relaxed museum day in Nice

Route: Menton → Nice → Menton Attractions: Musée Matisse and another municipal museum Time needed: Approximately 6–8 hours including travel, local transport and a meal Nice offers an excellent selection of art and history museums. You could spend the morning at Musée Matisse in Cimiez, then visit another municipal collection later in the day. Both types of visit are included in the French Riviera Pass. But Nice already operates a particularly good museum ticket.

### Nice Museums Pass

The city offers a four-day municipal museum pass for €15. It covers its participating municipal museums and galleries. That's less than half the price of a 24-hour French Riviera Pass.

### The cost comparison

| Expense | Nice Museums Pass | French Riviera Pass |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Museums | €15 for four days | Included |
| French Riviera Pass | Not needed | €30 |
| Return TER Menton–Nice | €15.40 | €15.40 |
| Local bus/tram | Extra if required | Extra if required |
| Total before local transport | €30.40 | €45.40 |

The return TER figure uses SNCF's published standard one-way Menton–Nice fare of €7.70.

### What about timing?

The TER journey averages approximately 40 minutes. Then you still have to reach the museum. Musée Matisse is in Cimiez, away from the central railway station. Allow time for a local bus connection or another suitable route. A museum visit can take 1–2 hours. If you add another attraction, lunch and the return journey, you're already looking at a substantial day.

### Verdict

For a conventional municipal-museum day, the Nice Museums Pass is the better choice. French Riviera Pass becomes more interesting only if you add genuinely valuable activities outside the municipal museum scheme.
fr:
## 4. Deuxième scénario : une journée tranquille dans les musées de Nice

Itinéraire : Menton → Nice → Menton. Programme : musée Matisse et un autre musée municipal. Prévoyez 6 à 8 heures avec trajets, correspondances et repas.

On peut consacrer la matinée au musée Matisse, à Cimiez, puis découvrir une autre collection municipale. Le French Riviera Pass les couvre, mais la ville propose déjà un billet particulièrement intéressant.

### Le Nice Museums Pass

Le forfait de quatre jours coûte **€15** pour les musées et galeries municipaux participants. C'est la moitié du pass touristique de 24 heures, avec une fenêtre de visite plus longue.

| Dépense | Nice Museums Pass | French Riviera Pass |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Musées | €15 pour quatre jours | Inclus |
| Pass touristique | Inutile | €30 |
| TER aller-retour Menton–Nice | €15.40 | €15.40 |
| Bus ou tram, si nécessaire | En supplément | En supplément |
| Total hors transport local | €30.40 | €45.40 |

Le calcul TER utilise le plein tarif simple publié de €7.70. Le trajet prend approximativement 40 minutes, auxquels s'ajoute l'accès au musée. Matisse est à Cimiez, pas à côté de Nice-Ville : prévoyez une liaison adaptée. Une visite prend facilement une à deux heures. Deux musées, le déjeuner et le retour remplissent déjà bien la journée.

### Verdict

Pour les seuls musées municipaux, privilégiez le forfait municipal. Le French Riviera Pass devient intéressant seulement si vous ajoutez des activités réellement souhaitées et avantageuses hors de ce réseau.

## 4. Secondo scenario: una tranquilla giornata nei musei di Nizza

Percorso: Mentone → Nizza → Mentone. Attività: Musée Matisse e un altro museo comunale. Prevedete circa 6–8 ore, includendo viaggio, trasporto locale e pasto.

Si può dedicare la mattina a Matisse, a Cimiez, e visitare un'altra collezione comunale più tardi. Il French Riviera Pass le comprende, ma Nizza offre già un biglietto particolarmente conveniente.

### Nice Museums Pass

Il pass comunale di quattro giorni costa **€15** e comprende i musei e le gallerie municipali aderenti. È la metà del prezzo del pass turistico di 24 ore, con più tempo a disposizione.

### Суттєва різниця в цінах

Сайт паса рекламує вартість заняття Galimard у €58. Проте сторінка самого організатора в Езі та його бронювання пропонують **Pause Cologne за €18 за одну композицію**, із 15 мл одеколону. Не плутайте коротке знайомство з одеколоном в Езі з довшими курсами створення парфумів, зокрема в Грассі.

| Витрата | Без паса | З пасом на 24 години |

### Практичний шлях

## 6. Scenario four: Monaco for one major attraction

Route: Menton → Monaco → Menton Main attraction: Oceanographic Museum of Monaco Time needed: Approximately 4–6 hours including travel and sightseeing Monaco is one of the easiest day trips from Menton. The TER journey is short, and the Oceanographic Museum is one of the region's major cultural attractions. The museum is included in the French Riviera Pass. However, admission prices can vary by date and visitor category.

### How to calculate this trip

A 24-hour French Riviera Pass costs €30. A standard return TER ticket from Menton to Monaco costs €8.20, based on SNCF's published €4.10 one-way fare. That means the pass itinerary costs at least €38.20 before any other paid local transport or extras. Without the pass, the cost is the museum's actual admission price on your date plus the same €8.20 train fare.

### What makes the pass worthwhile?

If your standalone museum ticket is below €30, buying the 24-hour pass solely for that one museum won't save money. You would need another included activity that you genuinely wanted to do. Walking around Monaco-Ville, visiting the harbour or admiring the outside of the Prince's Palace does not create additional pass savings if those activities are free.

### Verdict

Don't purchase French Riviera Pass automatically for a single Monaco museum visit. Check the actual museum price and compare it with €30. The short journey makes Monaco attractive from Menton, but it doesn't make an unnecessary pass financially worthwhile.

### Verdict

For these four visits, separate admissions are cheaper and allow more flexibility. A 72-hour pass needs other confirmed, worthwhile included activities to become competitive. Do not add visits merely to recover a sunk pass cost; weigh travel, opening hours and how much sightseeing you actually enjoy.

## 10. What does transport really add from Menton?

For visitors based in Menton, train fares are one of the most predictable additional expenses.

### Confirmed standard TER fares

| Journey | One-way | Return |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Menton–Nice | €7.70 | €15.40 |
| Menton–Monaco | €4.10 | €8.20 |

These are SNCF’s published standard adult fares checked on 2 November 2026. Discount cards, group fares and other regional products can reduce the cost. For Beaulieu-sur-Mer, Èze and other intermediate stations, check the precise fare for your chosen departure and destination. Don't calculate an all-inclusive travel budget by substituting the Nice fare for every station.

### Local buses and trams

The French Riviera Pass doesn't include ordinary local transport. For Nice, the official pass FAQ currently lists optional Lignes d'Azur passes at:

- €7 for one day.

- €13 for two days.

- €20 for seven days.

These are separate transport products. A single journey ticket may be cheaper if you only need one or two rides.

### What about Pass SudAzur Explore?

If you're planning several regional excursions from Menton, look separately at Pass SudAzur Explore. Its advertised three-day adult price is €35, with longer durations also available. It covers participating regional public transport networks, including eligible rail travel across Alpes-Maritimes and Monaco. However, it's a transport pass, not a replacement for admission tickets to museums and villas. Some visitors may benefit from buying both products, but only if the numbers justify it.

## 11. Why staying in Menton changes the calculation

Someone staying in central Nice can often visit several nearby attractions without travelling far. A visitor staying in Menton has a different starting point. A day in Nice includes the journey to the station, the train, local connections, the museum visit, lunch and the return. A day visiting villas on Cap Ferrat has its own final transport and walking requirements. And a workshop in Èze might require advance reservations and a connection beyond the coastal railway.

### The pass rewards concentrated sightseeing

French Riviera Pass is most effective when you're visiting several paid attractions within a limited period. But Menton is also a place where visitors often prefer a slower rhythm. You might spend the morning at the covered market, walk along Promenade du Soleil and visit Monaco the following afternoon. That doesn't produce much value from an attraction pass.

### The practical question

Would you still choose all these activities if you weren't trying to recover the cost of a pass? If the answer is no, the pass may be encouraging unnecessary spending rather than saving money.

## 12. Families: calculate each ticket separately

The French Riviera Pass is sold at a single standard price rather than offering an automatic lower-priced child version. But many attractions offer reduced or free admission to younger visitors. For example:

- Villa Kérylos offers free entry to children under seven and reduced tickets for ages 7–17.

- Villa Ephrussi offers reduced tickets for ages 7–17.

- Nice's municipal museums provide free admission to children under 18 under the published rules.

That changes the economics significantly. An adult might save money using the pass while their child would spend more.

### Our recommendation for families

Calculate the adult and child admissions separately. Don't automatically buy the same pass for every family member. Use the official French Riviera Pass savings calculator with the children's actual ages and desired activities. Age restrictions also apply to certain included experiences, so confirm whether a workshop or activity is genuinely suitable.

## 13. How to calculate whether the pass is worth buying

Use this formula: Your actual saving = the cheapest valid individual tickets for your planned activities − the price of the French Riviera Pass. When comparing different routes, include any transport costs that differ. The word cheapest is important. If two attractions offer a €24 combined ticket, don't compare the pass against their €33 combined standard single-ticket price. Likewise, if you qualify for a reduced museum ticket, use that reduced rate.

### A practical five-step method

- Choose the attractions you genuinely want to visit.

- Confirm they're included in the current French Riviera Pass.

- Find their ordinary tickets, combined offers and reduced rates.

- Check opening hours, bookings, travel time and realistic connections.

- Compare the total with the 24-, 48- or 72-hour pass.

Don't include activities merely because they're free with the pass. They should be activities you would otherwise be willing to purchase.

## 13. Comment décider si le pass vaut son prix

**Économie réelle = meilleurs billets valables pour les activités prévues − prix du pass.** Si les itinéraires diffèrent, ajoutez les transports qui changent. « Meilleurs billets » inclut les billets jumelés et les tarifs réduits : ne comparez pas €30 au total de €33 si un billet à €24 existe.

### Une méthode en cinq étapes

- Choisir les visites que l'on souhaite vraiment faire.
- Confirmer leur inclusion actuelle dans le pass.
- Chercher billets ordinaires, offres combinées et réductions.
- Vérifier horaires, réservations et correspondances réalistes.
- Comparer le total aux pass de 24, 48 et 72 heures.

Ne comptez pas une activité seulement parce qu'elle est incluse : elle doit avoir un intérêt que vous auriez accepté de payer.

## 13. Come decidere se conviene

**Risparmio reale = biglietti validi più economici per le attività scelte − costo del pass.** Confrontando percorsi diversi aggiungete i trasporti che cambiano. «Più economici» comprende biglietti congiunti e riduzioni: non confrontate €30 con €33 se esiste un ingresso combinato da €24.

### Cinque passi pratici

- Scegliere le attrazioni che volete davvero visitare.
- Confermare l'inclusione nel pass attuale.
- Cercare biglietti ordinari, combinazioni e riduzioni.
- Verificare aperture, prenotazioni e collegamenti realistici.
- Confrontare il totale con i pass di 24, 48 e 72 ore.

Non contate un'attività soltanto perché inclusa: dovrebbe essere qualcosa per cui sareste disposti a pagare comunque.

## 13. Як визначити, чи варто купувати пас

**Реальна економія = найдешевші чинні окремі квитки для обраних занять − ціна паса.** Порівнюючи різні маршрути, врахуйте транспортні витрати, які відрізняються. «Найдешевші» включає знижки та комбіновані квитки: не порівнюйте пас із €33 за два звичайні входи, якщо існує спільний за €24.

### П'ять практичних кроків

- Виберіть пам'ятки, які справді хочете відвідати.
- Підтвердьте їх включення в актуальний пас.
- Знайдіть звичайні квитки, комбіновані пропозиції та знижки.
- Перевірте години, бронювання й реалістичні пересадки.
- Порівняйте суму з пасами на 24, 48 і 72 години.

Не додавайте заняття лише тому, що воно включене. Це має бути те, за що ви й без паса були б готові заплатити.

## 14. Mistakes that make the pass less valuable

### Buying it before confirming availability

Some workshops and guided tours require reservations. Being listed as included doesn't guarantee an available place at your preferred time.

### Forgetting the journey from Menton

A €30 pass doesn't cover your TER ticket to Nice or Monaco.

### Ignoring combined admission tickets

This is particularly important for Villa Kérylos and Villa Ephrussi.

### Paying for free experiences indirectly

A free waterfront walk, public garden or view from a promenade doesn't become financially valuable simply because it appears near a paid attraction.

### Booking too much in one day

Travel time, lunch, queues and opening hours all limit what can comfortably fit into a day. If a pass makes you feel obliged to visit five museums when you'd genuinely enjoy two, it's probably the wrong choice.

### Forgetting the 24-hour clock

The pass is valid for consecutive hours after first use. But that doesn't mean every attraction is open around the clock. A museum may close at 5 p.m. even when your pass remains valid until the following morning.

## 14. Les erreurs qui diminuent l'intérêt du pass

### Acheter avant de vérifier les places

Une activité incluse ne garantit pas une place à l'heure souhaitée. Certains ateliers ou visites doivent être réservés.

### Oublier les trajets et les offres jumelées

Le pass à €30 ne paie pas le TER vers Nice ou Monaco. Le billet Kérylos–Ephrussi reste essentiel à comparer.

### Compter les promenades gratuites comme économies

Une vue depuis une promenade ou un jardin public ne devient pas une économie du pass parce qu'elle se trouve près d'un site payant.

### Trop remplir la journée

Déjeuner, files, transports et ouvertures limitent le programme. Si vous vous forcez à cinq musées au lieu de deux agréables, le pass n'est probablement pas adapté.

### Oublier les horaires réels

La validité consécutive ne signifie pas que les sites ouvrent en continu. Un musée peut fermer à 17 h alors que le pass reste valable jusqu'au lendemain.

## 14. Errori che rendono il pass meno conveniente

### Comprare prima di verificare la disponibilità

Un'attività inclusa non garantisce un posto all'ora preferita. Alcuni laboratori e visite guidate richiedono prenotazione.

### Dimenticare viaggio e biglietti combinati

Il pass da €30 non paga il TER verso Nizza o Monaco. Il biglietto Kérylos–Ephrussi resta un confronto indispensabile.

### Attribuire valore a passeggiate gratuite

Un lungomare, un giardino pubblico o una vista non diventano un risparmio del pass perché vicini a un'attrazione pagante.

### Riempire troppo la giornata

Trasporti, pranzo, code e orari limitano le visite. Se vi obbligate a cinque musei quando ne godreste due, probabilmente il pass non fa per voi.

### Confondere validità e apertura

Le ore consecutive non significano apertura continua. Un museo può chiudere alle 17 mentre il pass resta valido fino alla mattina dopo.

## 14. Помилки, через які пас стає менш вигідним

### Купівля до перевірки місць

Наявність заняття у списку не гарантує вільного місця в бажаний час. Деякі майстер-класи та екскурсії потрібно бронювати.

### Забуті дорога й комбіновані квитки

Пас за €30 не покриває TER до Ніцци чи Монако. Спільний вхід Керілос–Ефруссі обов'язково слід порівняти.

### Безплатні прогулянки як нібито економія

Набережна, громадський сад або краєвид не стають заощадженням від паса через сусідство з платною пам'яткою.

### Перевантаження дня

Дорога, обід, черги й години роботи обмежують програму. Якщо пас змушує йти в п'ять музеїв замість двох приємних, найімовірніше, він вам не підходить.

### Плутанина між терміном дії та годинами роботи

Безперервні години паса не означають цілодобове відкриття пам'яток. Музей може зачинитися о 17:00, хоча пас діятиме до наступного ранку.

## Frequently asked questions

### Is the French Riviera Pass worth buying if I stay in Menton?

Sometimes. It is most useful for higher-priced included activities and several confirmed visits, but none of the fixed-price example programmes here beats the cheapest separate tickets. For quieter sightseeing or trips focused on municipal museums and historic villas, cheaper individual or combined tickets may exist.

### Does the French Riviera Pass include trains from Menton?

No. Ordinary regional trains, buses and trams are not included.

### How much does the French Riviera Pass cost?

The current all-inclusive passes cost €30 for 24 hours, €45 for 48 hours and €65 for 72 hours.

### Is Villa Ephrussi de Rothschild included?

Yes. But when combining Ephrussi with Villa Kérylos, compare the €24 combined admission before buying a pass.

### Is the Monaco Oceanographic Museum included?

Yes. Compare the museum's date-specific adult admission with the pass price and any other activities you plan.

### Can I use the pass on consecutive days?

Yes. Its validity is measured in consecutive hours beginning with first use.

### Can I visit the same museum twice?

Normally no. Each included site or experience can be used once per pass.

### Is there a child discount?

The French Riviera Pass has a standard price. Calculate separately because individual attractions may offer free or reduced child admission.

### Is the Nice Museums Pass better?

For visiting only Nice municipal museums, the €15 four-day museum pass is often considerably better value.

### Can I combine a French Riviera Pass with a transport pass?

Yes, where their terms allow. But check whether the resulting total is cheaper than purchasing only the tickets you need.

## Questions fréquentes

### Le pass est-il intéressant depuis Menton ?

Parfois, pour plusieurs prestations réellement coûteuses et confirmées. Aucun des exemples à prix fixe de ce guide ne bat toutefois les meilleures entrées séparées.

### Inclut-il les trains ?

Non : TER, bus et tramways ordinaires sont exclus.

### Combien coûte-t-il ?

€30 pour 24 heures, €45 pour 48, €65 pour 72.

### Ephrussi et le musée océanographique sont-ils inclus ?

Oui. Comparez le billet jumelé des villas à €24 et le tarif du musée de Monaco à votre date.

### Peut-on l'utiliser plusieurs jours ou revenir au même musée ?

La validité est consécutive après activation. Chaque site inclus n'est normalement accessible qu'une fois.

### Existe-t-il une réduction enfant ?

Pas de tarif réduit automatique du pass ; calculez les gratuités et réductions propres aux attractions.

### Le forfait municipal de Nice est-il préférable ?

Souvent oui pour les seuls musées municipaux : €15 pour quatre jours. On peut aussi examiner un titre de transport séparé, selon ses conditions, sans supposer que cumuler les pass est économique.

## Domande frequenti

### Conviene da Mentone?

A volte, per più attività di valore elevato e confermate. Nessuno degli esempi a prezzo fisso di questa guida batte però i migliori biglietti separati.

### Include il treno?

No: treni regionali, bus e tram ordinari sono esclusi.

### Quanto costa?

€30 per 24 ore, €45 per 48 e €65 per 72.

### Ephrussi e il Museo Oceanografico sono inclusi?

Sì. Confrontate il biglietto congiunto delle ville da €24 e l'effettivo prezzo del museo di Monaco alla vostra data.

### Si usa per più giorni o più volte nello stesso museo?

La validità è consecutiva dalla prima attivazione. Normalmente ogni sito incluso è accessibile una sola volta.

### Esiste uno sconto bambini?

Non automaticamente sul pass; calcolate gratuità e riduzioni delle singole attrazioni.

### È meglio il pass museale comunale?

Spesso sì per i soli musei comunali: €15 per quattro giorni. Potete valutare anche un titolo di trasporto separato, alle sue condizioni, senza supporre che sommare pass faccia risparmiare.

## Поширені запитання

### Чи вигідний пас із Ментона?

Іноді — для кількох справді дорогих підтверджених занять. Проте жодна програма з фіксованою ціною в цьому гайді не дешевша з пасом, ніж із найкращими окремими квитками.

### Чи входять потяги?

Ні. Звичайні регіональні потяги, автобуси й трамваї не включені.

### Скільки він коштує?

€30 на 24 години, €45 на 48 і €65 на 72.

### Чи включені Ефруссі та Океанографічний музей?

Так. Але порівняйте спільний квиток двох вілл за €24 і фактичну ціну музею Монако на вашу дату.

### Чи можна використовувати кілька днів і повертатися до того самого музею?

Години відраховуються поспіль після активації. Кожне включене місце зазвичай доступне лише один раз.

### Чи є дитяча знижка?

Не автоматично на пас. Порахуйте безплатні й пільгові входи кожної пам'ятки.

### Чи кращий міський музейний абонемент Ніцци?

Часто так, якщо потрібні лише муніципальні музеї: €15 на чотири дні. Можна також розглянути окремий транспортний продукт за його умовами, не припускаючи, що поєднання пасів обов'язково дешевше.

## Final thoughts: don't buy the pass until you've chosen the trip

The French Riviera Pass can be an excellent sightseeing product. But it isn't automatically the cheapest way to explore the region from Menton. A programme containing several genuinely higher-value included activities may produce savings. The short Pause Cologne workshop alone does not: its provider price is €18. For a relaxed day visiting two historic villas, the official combined ticket is cheaper. For Nice's municipal museums, the city's own museum pass often makes more sense.

And for a short Monaco visit focused on walking and one museum, buying individual tickets may be perfectly adequate. Choose your experiences first. Calculate the tickets second. Buy the pass only if the result genuinely saves money. That way, your holiday remains organised around the places you want to see, rather than the need to justify something you've already purchased.

## Conclusion : choisir la sortie avant d'acheter le pass

Le French Riviera Pass peut être utile, mais n'est pas automatiquement la façon la moins chère d'explorer depuis Menton. Un ensemble de prestations coûteuses peut convenir ; Pause Cologne à €18, seul, non. Pour deux villas, le billet jumelé est moins cher. Pour les musées municipaux, le forfait de la ville est souvent préférable. Pour Monaco avec une promenade et un musée, les billets individuels peuvent suffire.

Choisissez les expériences, calculez les billets, puis achetez seulement si l'économie est réelle. Vos vacances restent ainsi organisées autour de vos envies, pas autour d'un achat à amortir.

Il French Riviera Pass può essere utile, ma non è automaticamente il modo più economico di esplorare da Mentone. Un insieme di attività costose può funzionare; Pause Cologne a €18 da sola no. French Riviera Pass може бути корисним, але не є автоматично найдешевшим способом мандрувати з Ментона. Набір дорогих включених занять іноді дає економію; лише Pause Cologne за €18 — ні.
